patch_description: Restructure into a modular pipeline: (1) a staggered hex-row layout generator places 26 centers in 5 rows (5,6,5,6,4 pattern), (2) radii are computed by an exact linear program (maximize Σr subject to pairwise distance and wall constraints) instead of the lossy greedy pairwise scaling — this alone drastically improves the achievable sum, (3) a bounded hill-climbing refinement perturbs center positions and re-solves the LP, accepting only improvements, so edge gaps get filled by naturally larger corner circles. A scipy-free fallback preserves the old pairwise scaling if scipy is unavailable. Same interface (construct_packing returning centers, radii, sum) is maintained.
